    About Us

    Who Invited Us to the Real Estate Party? 👋

    Welcome to Comprops—an AI-powered commercial real estate platform for people to buy, sell, and lease commercial real estate in Pittsburgh, PA.

    We’re a crew of industry veterans who have spent decades in the trenches of property development, urban asset management, and daily transactions. We’ve done it all: from wrangling massive industrial flex warehouses to bringing neighborhood retail spaces and investment portfolios to life.

    Along the way, we spent way too many hours wrestling with clunky systems, endless paperwork, and the kind of market friction that makes everyone want to pull their hair out. We figured there had to be a better way. So, we rolled up our sleeves and built one.

    Why Comprops?

    We built comprops.com to cut through the noise and inject a little sanity (and speed) into how people lease, buy, and sell commercial space.

    By combining hard-won industry wisdom with a clean, high-performance digital platform, we’ve created a transparent, stress-free hub where great properties and the right deals actually find each other. Whether you're hunting for your next tenant, buying a new asset, or selling a property, we make the process smooth and modern.

    Let’s Chat! ☕

    Got questions? Want to talk shop, or just curious about what we’re building next? We’re always down to chat.

    Drop us a line anytime at support@comprops.com—we promise a real human will write back.
